props.gloss_en: the mishnah: three who ate as one are not permitted to divide
Shmuel: three who sat down to eat as one, and have not yet eaten, are not permitted to divide
Shmuel (second version): this is what it teaches -- three who sat down to eat as one, even though each eats from his own loaf, are not permitted to divide
Rav Huna: three who came from three companies are not permitted to divide
Rav Chisda: and that is where they came from three companies of three people
Rava: we said this only where those [companies] did not first include them in a zimmun in their own place
Rava: but if they included them in a zimmun in their place, the zimmun has departed from them
the mishnah: a bed half of which was stolen or lost, or which brothers or partners divided, is pure
the mishnah: if they restored it, it receives impurity from here on
Rava: from here on, yes; retroactively, no -- so once they divided it, the impurity departed from it
